summary.value: Reviewers found the paper thorough and well-executed but raised consistent concerns about limited methodological novelty and unclear positioning relative to prior activation-steering and probing work. While the preventative steering case study was viewed as the strongest contribution, the overall approach was seen as largely incremental. Additional concerns included trait entanglement, lack of stronger naive baselines, and insufficient clarity in the main methodological exposition. Overall, despite strong engineering effort, reviewers did not see a sufficiently distinctive contribution.

reviewer_concerns.value: The rebuttal effectively clarified presentation issues, emphasized preventative steering, and added robustness and methodological details. It also improved contextualization relative to prior work. However, key concerns remain: the novelty gap relative to existing steering methods, high correlations between traits undermining specificity, and the lack of compelling naive-baseline comparisons. Questions about conceptual insight and the scope of contribution were only partially addressed. These unresolved issues continue to drive reviewers’ reservations.
